title: the dancer teleports on the clap and blinks at the drop
story: Not Like Us at 99.5 bpm, a hip-hop backbeat with the drop at 247 (rms 0.10 to 0.42). The approach is a dim room: four intro hits (32, 60, 68, 78) make the body teleport to a new corner with an eye flash. The build tightens the brightness and contrast, and the drop releases a shake and a zoom punch. After the drop the kick jumps the body in size and shakes it, and every clap on beats 2 and 4 teleports it to a mirrored corner and blinks it. At the break (845) the beat falls out, the body stops in the centre and its gaze slows, following the few hits that still sound.
